audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Judah's descent, Tamar, levirate duty, pledge/recognition motif, Judah's confession, and Perez/Zerah birth. Sensitive material is rendered restrainedly for app use.

verses.restored: At that time Judah went down from his brothers and turned aside to a man of Adullam named Hirah.

familiar.text: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

modern.text: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.

original.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֥רֶד יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת אֶחָ֑יו וַיֵּ֛ט עַד אִ֥ישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ חִירָֽה

verses.restored: Judah saw there the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua; he took her and came to her.

familiar.text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

modern.text: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.

original.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁ֧ם יְהוּדָ֛ה בַּת אִ֥ישׁ כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ שׁ֑וּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: She conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er.

familiar.text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

modern.text: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and Judah named him Er.

original.text: וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵֽר

verses.restored: She conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.

familiar.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

modern.text: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.

original.text: וַתַּ֥הַר ע֖וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ אוֹנָֽן

verses.restored: She bore still another son and called his name Shelah; Judah was at Chezib when she bore him.

familiar.text: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

modern.text: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.

original.text: וַתֹּ֤סֶף עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה בִכְזִ֖יב בְּלִדְתָּ֥הּ אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Judah took a woman for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

familiar.text: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

modern.text: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֧ח יְהוּדָ֛ה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְעֵ֣ר בְּכוֹר֑וֹ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ תָּמָֽר

verses.restored: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was evil in the eyes of the Eternal, and the Eternal put him to death.

familiar.text: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

modern.text: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so the LORD put him to death.

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְמִתֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Judah said to Onan, Go to your brother’s woman and perform the brother-in-law duty, and raise up seed for your brother.

familiar.text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

modern.text: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ לְאוֹנָ֔ן בֹּ֛א אֶל אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יךָ וְיַבֵּ֣ם אֹתָ֑הּ וְהָקֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיךָ

verses.restored: Onan knew the seed would not be his, so when he went to his brother’s woman he wasted it, so as not to give seed to his brother.

familiar.text: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

modern.text: But Onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother’s wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.

original.text: וַיֵּ֣דַע אוֹנָ֔ן כִּ֛י לֹּ֥א ל֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַזָּ֑רַע וְהָיָ֞ה אִם בָּ֨א אֶל אֵ֤שֶׁת אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת אַ֔רְצָה לְבִלְתִּ֥י נְתָן זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיו

verses.restored: What he did was evil in the eyes of the Eternal, and he put him to death also.

familiar.text: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.

modern.text: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD, so He put Onan to death as well.

original.text: וַיֵּ֛רַע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיָּ֖מֶת גַּם אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in your father’s house until Shelah my son grows up, for he said, Lest he also die like his brothers. So Tamar went and dwelled in her father’s house.

familiar.text: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

modern.text: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְתָמָ֨ר כַּלָּת֜וֹ שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית אָבִ֗יךְ עַד יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔י כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן יָמ֥וּת גַּם ה֖וּא כְּאֶחָ֑יו וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֔ר וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ

verses.restored: Many days passed, and the daughter of Shua, Judah’s woman, died. After Judah was comforted, he went up to his sheep shearers at Timnah, he and Hirah his Adullamite friend.

familiar.text: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

modern.text: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had finished mourning, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.

original.text: וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתָּ֖מָת בַּת שׁ֣וּעַ אֵֽשֶׁת יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּ֜עַל עַל גֹּֽזֲזֵ֤י צֹאנוֹ֙ ה֗וּא וְחִירָ֛ה רֵעֵ֥הוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִ֖י תִּמְנָֽתָה

verses.restored: Tamar was told, Look, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

familiar.text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

modern.text: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,”

original.text: וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְתָמָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֥ה חָמִ֛יךְ עֹלֶ֥ה תִמְנָ֖תָה לָגֹ֥ז צֹאנֽוֹ

verses.restored: She removed her widow’s garments, covered herself with a veil, wrapped herself, and sat at the entrance of Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah, because she saw that Shelah had grown and she had not been given to him as a woman.

familiar.text: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

modern.text: she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.

original.text: וַתָּסַר֩ בִּגְדֵ֨י אַלְמְנוּתָ֜הּ מֵֽעָלֶ֗יהָ וַתְּכַ֤ס בַּצָּעִיף֙ וַתִּתְעַלָּ֔ף וַתֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח עֵינַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ תִּמְנָ֑תָה כִּ֤י רָאֲתָה֙ כִּֽי גָדַ֣ל שֵׁלָ֔ה וְהִ֕וא לֹֽא נִתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה

verses.restored: Judah saw her and thought she was a prostitute, because she had covered her face.

familiar.text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

modern.text: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.

original.text: וַיִּרְאֶ֣הָ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיַּחְשְׁבֶ֖הָ לְזוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֥י כִסְּתָ֖ה פָּנֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: He turned aside to her by the road and said, Please let me come to you, for he did not know she was his daughter-in-law. She said, What will you give me, that you may come to me?

familiar.text: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

modern.text: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.” “What will you give me for sleeping with you?” she inquired.

original.text: וַיֵּ֨ט אֵלֶ֜יהָ אֶל הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽבָה נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖וֹ הִ֑וא וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מַה תִּתֶּן לִּ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: He said, I will send a young goat from the flock. She said, Will you give a pledge until you send it?

familiar.text: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

modern.text: “I will send you a young goat from my flock,” Judah answered. But she replied, “Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֛י אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח גְּדִֽי עִזִּ֖ים מִן הַצֹּ֑אן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר אִם תִּתֵּ֥ן עֵרָב֖וֹן עַ֥ד שָׁלְחֶֽךָ

verses.restored: He said, What pledge shall I give you? She said, Your seal, your cord, and your staff that is in your hand. He gave them to her and came to her, and she conceived by him.

familiar.text: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

modern.text: “What pledge should I give you?” he asked. She answered, “Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.” So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָֽעֵרָבוֹן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן לָּךְ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ֙ וּפְתִילֶ֔ךָ וּמַטְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָּ֛הּ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וַתַּ֥הַר לֽוֹ

verses.restored: She rose and went away, removed her veil from upon her, and put on her widow’s garments.

familiar.text: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

modern.text: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.

original.text: וַתָּ֣קָם וַתֵּ֔לֶךְ וַתָּ֥סַר צְעִיפָ֖הּ מֵעָלֶ֑יהָ וַתִּלְבַּ֖שׁ בִּגְדֵ֥י אַלְמְנוּתָֽהּ

verses.restored: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his Adullamite friend to take the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he did not find her.

familiar.text: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

modern.text: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶת גְּדִ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ רֵעֵ֣הוּ הָֽעֲדֻלָּמִ֔י לָקַ֥חַת הָעֵרָב֖וֹן מִיַּ֣ד הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹ֖א מְצָאָֽהּ

verses.restored: He asked the men of her place, Where is the shrine-woman who was at Enaim by the road? They said, No shrine-woman has been here.

familiar.text: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

modern.text: He asked the men of that place, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?” “No shrine prostitute has been here,” they answered.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֤י מְקֹמָהּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַיֵּ֧ה הַקְּדֵשָׁ֛ה הִ֥וא בָעֵינַ֖יִם עַל הַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹא הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה

verses.restored: He returned to Judah and said, I did not find her; also the men of the place said, No shrine-woman has been here.

familiar.text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

modern.text: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”

original.text: וַיָּ֨שָׁב֙ אֶל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֑יהָ וְגַ֨ם אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה

verses.restored: Judah said, Let her keep them, lest we become contemptible. Look, I sent this young goat, but you did not find her.

familiar.text: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

modern.text: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ תִּֽקַּֽח לָ֔הּ פֶּ֖ן נִהְיֶ֣ה לָב֑וּז הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי֙ הַגְּדִ֣י הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א מְצָאתָֽהּ

verses.restored: About three months later Judah was told, Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the prostitute, and also look, she is pregnant. Judah said, Bring her out, and let her be burned.

familiar.text: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

modern.text: About three months later, Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.” “Bring her out!” Judah replied. “Let her be burned to death!”

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י כְּמִשְׁלֹ֣שׁ חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִֽיהוּדָ֤ה לֵֽאמֹר֙ זָֽנְתָה֙ תָּמָ֣ר כַּלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְגַ֛ם הִנֵּ֥ה הָרָ֖ה לִזְנוּנִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֔ה הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵֽף

verses.restored: As she was being brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man to whom these belong, I am pregnant. She said, Recognize, please, whose seal, cords, and staff these are.

familiar.text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

modern.text: As she was being brought out, Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.” And she added, “Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?”

original.text: הִ֣וא מוּצֵ֗את וְהִ֨יא שָׁלְחָ֤ה אֶל חָמִ֨יהָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר אֵ֣לֶּה לּ֔וֹ אָנֹכִ֖י הָרָ֑ה וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַכֶּר נָ֔א לְמִ֞י הַחֹתֶ֧מֶת וְהַפְּתִילִ֛ים וְהַמַּטֶּ֖ה הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Judah recognized them and said, She is more righteous than I, because I did not give her to Shelah my son. And he did not know her again.

familiar.text: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

modern.text: Judah recognized the items and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not have relations with her again. The Birth of Perez and Zerah

original.text: וַיַּכֵּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ צָֽדְקָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔נִּי כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֥ן לֹא נְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְשֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֑י וְלֹֽא יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְדַעְתָּֽה

verses.restored: When the time came for her to give birth, look, twins were in her womb.

familiar.text: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

modern.text: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.

original.text: וַיְהִ֖י בְּעֵ֣ת לִדְתָּ֑הּ וְהִנֵּ֥ה תְאוֹמִ֖ים בְּבִטְנָֽהּ

verses.restored: As she was giving birth, one put out a hand, and the midwife tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, This one came out first.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

modern.text: And as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. “This one came out first,” she announced.

original.text: וַיְהִ֥י בְלִדְתָּ֖הּ וַיִּתֶּן יָ֑ד וַתִּקַּ֣ח הַמְיַלֶּ֗דֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עַל יָד֤וֹ שָׁנִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֖ה יָצָ֥א רִאשֹׁנָֽה

verses.restored: But as he drew back his hand, look, his brother came out. She said, What a breach you have made for yourself! So his name was called Perez.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

modern.text: But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י כְּמֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ וְהִנֵּה֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מַה פָּרַ֖צְתָּ עָלֶ֣יךָ פָּ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ פָּֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

familiar.text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

modern.text: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.

original.text: וְאַחַר֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל יָד֖וֹ הַשָּׁנִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ זָֽרַח
